subtitle: Supporting the training and placement of service dogs with returning veterans.
brief:
Build a one-page fundraiser site for "Welcome Them Home" — supporting the training and placement of service dogs with returning veterans.

The page features THREE looping hero videos in sequence (a 3-shot emotional arc: ear-twitch at the door → tail-thunder mid-hallway → tackle-embrace on the porch) and a prominent "Support Veteran Service Dogs" button linking to https://example.com/donate.
visual_bible: Late-afternoon golden hour, warm low sun raking through a screen door. Suburban Midwestern porch with chipped white paint and a worn welcome mat. Golden retriever with a greying muzzle and slightly cloudy eyes. Returning service member in fatigues, seen primarily from behind. Shot on 35mm film, shallow depth of field, soft dust motes catching sunlight. Documentary realism — NOT slow motion, NOT triumphant-orchestral, NOT staged. Warm honey-and-amber palette with cool screen-door shadow. 16:9.
shots: HOOK: Tight on the dog's face at the screen door, one ear twitching as it hears a distant car door close. Catchlights in the eyes. Stillness about to break.
ESCALATION: Hallway floor level, dog mid-sprint toward the door, tail a blur, claws skittering on hardwood, late sun stripes across the floor.
PAYOFF: Wide on the porch from inside the screen door: service member kneeling, dog mid-leap into their arms, duffel bag on the steps.
palette_hint: warm honey and golden-hour amber with deep navy or burgundy accents
